notes: Held at Douglass Community Center and the Loudoun County Government Center, both in Leesburg. The page does not mention a later date.
name: Loudoun Youth in Government Day
org: Loudoun County Board of Supervisors and county staff
what_you_do: One day with county leaders. You have lunch with the Board of Supervisors, join a panel and tour a community center. You also sit on the dais during a Board meeting.
who_can_apply: Loudoun County high school juniors and seniors.
deadline_text: Page lists Tuesday, October 20, 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. (no year shown; matches 2026). No application deadline listed, so apply now or ask.
how_to_apply: Send the Youth in Government Day application online. The page has a JotForm link.
